```{r trying to autoalign and assign}
if (!requireNamespace("Biostrings", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("Biostrings", repos = "http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/")
}
library(Biostrings)

map_phosphosites <- function(human_seq, mouse_seq) {
  # Restrict to first 31 amino acids
  human_seq <- substr(human_seq, 1, 31)
  mouse_seq <- substr(mouse_seq, 1, 31)
  
  # Ensure both sequences are 31 characters long
  if (nchar(human_seq) != 31 || nchar(mouse_seq) != 31) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # Align sequences with a focus on the center (position 16)
  alignment <- pairwiseAlignment(human_seq, mouse_seq, type = "local")
  
  # Extract aligned sequences
  aligned_human <- as.character(alignedPattern(alignment))
  aligned_mouse <- as.character(alignedSubject(alignment))
  
  # Check central position
  human_center <- substr(aligned_human, 16, 16)
  mouse_center <- substr(aligned_mouse, 16, 16)
  
  if (human_center != "-") {
    # Return the mouse residue at the central position
    return(mouse_center)
  } else {
    # If the central position does not align, return NA
    return(NA)
  }
}

mapped_results <- lapply(unique(filtered_hphosavs_sig$Protein), function(protein) {
  # Subset human and mouse data for the current protein
  human_data <- filtered_hphosavs_sig[filtered_hphosavs_sig$Protein == protein, ]
  mouse_data <- filtered_mphosavs_sig[filtered_mphosavs_sig$Protein == protein, ]
  
  if (nrow(human_data) > 0 & nrow(mouse_data) > 0) {
    # Map phosphosites for each sequence window
    mapped_sites <- Map(function(hseq, mseq) {
      map_phosphosites(hseq, mseq)
    },
    hseq = human_data$Sequence.window,
    mseq = rep(mouse_data$Sequence.window, length.out = nrow(human_data)))
    
    # Add mapped sites to the human data
    human_data$mapped_mouse_site <- unlist(mapped_sites)
  } else {
    human_data$mapped_mouse_site <- NA
  }
  
  return(human_data)
})

# Combine all results
mapped_human_to_mouse <- do.call(rbind, mapped_results)



```

```{r}

# Install packages if you haven't already
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("clusterProfiler")
BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")  # For human genes; change to "org.Mm.eg.db" for mouse
BiocManager::install("enrichplot")  # Optional for plotting results
BiocManager::install("pathview")  # For visualizing KEGG pathways

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)  # Use org.Mm.eg.db for mouse, org.Rn.eg.db for rat, etc.
library(enrichplot)


# Convert to gene lists to Entrez IDs (for human genes), 
gene_ids_opposite <- bitr(c(unique(opposite_direction_both$human_gene)), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
gene_ids_same <- bitr(c(unique(same_direction_both$human_gene)), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
gene_ids_other <- bitr(c(unique(not_signif_or_other_direction_both$human_gene)), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

gene_ids_total <- bitr(c(unique(merged_data_NArm$human_gene)), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# Run KEGG pathway enrichment analysis
kegg_results_opposite <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = gene_ids_opposite$ENTREZID,
   #universe = gene_ids_total$ENTREZID,
  organism = "hsa",  # "hsa" for human; use "mmu" for mouse, "rno" for rat, etc.
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

kegg_results_same <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = gene_ids_same$ENTREZID,
  universe = gene_ids_total$ENTREZID,
  organism = "hsa",  # "hsa" for human; use "mmu" for mouse, "rno" for rat, etc.
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

kegg_results_other <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = gene_ids_other$ENTREZID,
  universe = gene_ids_total$ENTREZID,
  organism = "hsa",  # "hsa" for human; use "mmu" for mouse, "rno" for rat, etc.
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

oppositekegg <- kegg_results_opposite@result %>% filter(qvalue < 0.05)
samekegg <- kegg_results_same@result %>% filter(qvalue < 0.05)
otherkegg <- kegg_results_other@result %>% filter(qvalue < 0.05)

# Check if mTOR pathway is among the enriched pathways
mtor_pathway_opposite <- kegg_results_opposite@result[grepl("mTOR", kegg_results_opposite@result$Description), ]
print(mtor_pathway_opposite)

mtor_pathway_same <- kegg_results_same@result[grepl("mTOR", kegg_results_same@result$Description), ]
print(mtor_pathway_same)

mtor_pathway_other <- kegg_results_other@result[grepl("mTOR", kegg_results_other@result$Description), ]
print(mtor_pathway_other)


# Visualize the pathways mtor="hsa04150", WNK is in different pathway
pathview(gene.data = gene_ids_total$ENTREZID, pathway.id = "hsa04150", species = "hsa")
pathview(gene.data = gene_ids_opposite$ENTREZID, pathway.id = "hsa04144", species = "hsa")

```
```{r a "net" phosphorylation approach}

net_direction_mouse <- mphosavs %>%
  group_by(main_gene) %>%
  summarize(mouse_direction = case_when(
    sum(directionfc == "PROP") > sum(directionfc == "INV") ~ "PROP",  # If more 'PROP' than 'INV'
    sum(directionfc == "INV") > sum(directionfc == "PROP") ~ "INV",  # If more 'INV' than 'PROP'
    TRUE ~ "OTHER"  # If equal or other cases (e.g., no 'PROP' or 'INV' detected)
  ))

net_direction_mouse <- net_direction_mouse %>%
  left_join(mapping, by = c("main_gene" = "mouse_gene"))

net_direction_human <- hphosavs %>%
  group_by(main_gene) %>%
  summarize(human_direction = case_when(
    sum(directionfc == "PROP") > sum(directionfc == "INV") ~ "PROP",  # If more 'PROP' than 'INV'
    sum(directionfc == "INV") > sum(directionfc == "PROP") ~ "INV",  # If more 'INV' than 'PROP'
    TRUE ~ "OTHER"  # If equal or other cases (e.g., no 'PROP' or 'INV' detected)
  )) %>% rename(human_gene = main_gene)

#if I wanted to count OTHER into it: sum(directionfc == "PROP") >= sum(directionfc == "INV") + sum(directionfc == "OTHER") ~ "PROP",  # More or equal 'PROP' than 'INV' + 'OTHER'

# Merge by gene to compare net directions
merged_net_direction <- left_join(net_direction_mouse, net_direction_human, by = "human_gene")

# Classify based on net phosphorylation direction
same_net_direction_both <- merged_net_direction %>%
  filter(mouse_direction == "PROP" & human_direction == "PROP" | 
         mouse_direction == "INV" & human_direction == "INV")

opposite_net_direction_both <- merged_net_direction %>%
  filter(mouse_direction == "PROP" & human_direction == "INV" | 
    mouse_direction == "PROP" & human_direction == "OTHER" | 
    mouse_direction == "INV" & human_direction == "PROP" | 
    mouse_direction == "INV" & human_direction == "OTHER"| 
    human_direction == "PROP" & mouse_direction == "OTHER" | 
    human_direction == "INV" & mouse_direction == "OTHER")

not_signif_or_other_net_direction_both <- merged_net_direction %>%
  filter(mouse_direction == "OTHER" & human_direction == "OTHER")

# Counts for Venn diagram
counts <- list(
  "Same direction" = same_net_direction_both$main_gene,
  "Opposite direction" = opposite_net_direction_both$main_gene,
  "Other/Not significant direction in either" = not_signif_or_other_net_direction_both$main_gene
)

```
